target_customer: LTL trucking carriers and cross-docking warehouse operators that bill by freight dimensions
problem: Shipment dimensions declared by senders are often wrong, so carriers lose revenue in rebillings and trailer space. Dedicated dimensioning stations are costly and slow the dock workflow.
business_model: B2B software per site using existing CCTV cameras (pricing not stated in sources)

founders.name: Julius Scheel
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built and scaled a virtual clinic at avi medical to seven-figure ARR.

founders.name: Nils Boerner
education: University of Queensland, Master's Data Science
founders.background_notes: Five years of computer vision work at deep-tech startups and in research, per YC page.

founders.name: Jago Wahl-Schwentker
founders.background_notes: First software engineer at Veli; his family runs an LTL trucking and cross-docking business per the Launch HN post.

competitors.name: CubiScan dock dimensioners
competitors.what: Ceiling or dock mounted dimensioning hardware
competitors.traction_then: FedEx Freight reported to have over 80 dimensioners deployed

competitors.name: Mettler Toledo laser dimensioning
competitors.what: Laser based pallet dimensioning heads, about one minute per pallet

competitors.name: vMeasure
competitors.what: Vendor selling computer vision freight dimensioners

technical_complexity.rationale: Metric 3D box fitting from uncalibrated warehouse CCTV, linked to barcode scans, with stated error under 1.5 inches. Legal use for trade also needs NTEP certification, which was pending.

defensibility.rationale: Models build on public research (MapAnything, MoGe), so the edge is integration with carrier workflows, data from customer cameras and certification, none of which is secured yet.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent response found as of late 2026.

market_need_then: NMFTA moved LTL classification to a density based system on 2025-07-19, making accurate dimensions more valuable. Founders spoke to over 50 trucking companies and one customer found dimension errors in about 10% of checked shipments (company stated).

branding.domain_note: Site at transload.ai, per YC page. Third party trackers reference transload.io, conflicting.

identity.logo: present on YC page, not described
identity.voice_and_tone: Technical and plain, tagline Computer vision for the loading dock

branding.community_and_virality: Launch HN post with technical comments from readers.

brand_strength.rationale: A descriptive name taken from the logistics term for moving freight between vehicles; no sourced brand assets or community beyond a Launch HN thread.

pivots.from: AI forklift route optimization inside cross-dock terminals
pivots.why: Founders say forklift routing was not the pain customers kept raising after more than 50 interviews

outcome_analysis: transload is a Spring 2026 YC company that is active. A founder with family access to LTL trucking and a computer vision team pivoted from forklift routing to dimensioning after customer interviews. No verified funding or exit exists, and NTEP certification is still pending, so no outcome can be assigned yet.
